---
title: "testthat snapshots change with the way the tests are run"
ref: PKG-02
categories: [Packages]
impact: silencieux
attendu: "an identical snapshot, whichever button is used"
versions: "All versions of {testthat} 3"
source: "Slack ThinkR (2024)"
---

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
# In RStudio, the file's "Run Tests" button
testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-display.R")

# Then from the console
devtools::test()
```

```text
── Failure ('test-display.R:3:3'): summary display ──
Snapshot of code has changed:
```
:::

This pitfall depends on the IDE and the test runner, so it cannot be replayed in the browser.

## Why

`expect_snapshot()` records the text output exactly as it is produced. That output depends on settings that differ from one runner to the next: console width, {cli} colours and Unicode characters, language, whether the package is loaded with `load_all()` or not.

A snapshot created with one runner can therefore fail with the other, or worse, be silently rewritten by whoever accepts the changes without reading them.

## The remedy

Always create and validate snapshots the same way, with `devtools::test()` or `devtools::check()`, and pin inside the test the settings that change the display.

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
test_that("summary display", {
  local_reproducible_output(width = 80, unicode = FALSE, crayon = FALSE)
  expect_snapshot(print(summarise_results(data)))
})
```
:::
